FN-CX6GHQW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 109
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator William M. Beasley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 109 as introduced appropriates $15,816,579 from the Education Trust Fund to
Tuskegee University for fiscal year 2026. In addition, this act will require at least $2,000,000 of
this appropriation to be expended for the agricultural research and extension service state match.
